title: UN report: How Asaduzzaman used BGB as 'strike force', wanted more helicopters deployed
note: News report summarizing OHCHR fact-finding claims about former home minister Asaduzzaman Khan Kamal and security-force coordination during the July-August 2024 uprising.
whyItMatters: It gives figure-specific reporting on Asaduzzaman Khan Kamal's alleged command and coordination role in the 2024 crackdown, based on the UN/OHCHR report.
